title: Workflow and Job Concurrency knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes Workflow and Job Concurrency?
options: Concurrency groups coordinate overlapping workflow/job runs and can cancel outdated work when that behavior is safe for the workload.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
questions.answer_key: Concurrency groups coordinate overlapping workflow/job runs and can cancel outdated work when that behavior is safe for the workload.
questions.explanation: This is the central behavior of workflow and job concurrency: Concurrency groups coordinate overlapping workflow/job runs and can cancel outdated work when that behavior is safe for the workload. Validate configuration and behavior against the current official reference before production use.

questions.prompt: How should a reviewer verify a change related to workflow and job concurrency?
options: Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
Assume the workflow is correct as soon as the YAML file is committed.
Retry every failure without looking at the exit code or preserving evidence.
Publish the workflow to production before reviewing its triggers and permissions.
questions.answer_key: Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
